rules.statement: A header comment in a CI workflow that describes when or in what order it runs (for example "as its last job") must match the jobs' actual `needs:` dependencies, and must not call a job the final step when other jobs run in parallel with it.
rules.why: A header that gets the job order wrong leads readers to think a job is the final step of the run when sibling jobs actually run alongside it.
rules.check: When a workflow's jobs or `needs:` lists change, read the header comments of the calling and called workflows. Flag any wording about ordering ("last", "final", "after X") that the dependency graph doesn't support.
